name: shifted-gear-pair
why: A module 2 pair, 12 and 30 teeth, pinion shifted x1 = 0.3 and wheel x2 = 0,, from spurGearPair with 0.1 mm of backlash. inv aw = inv 20 + 2 tan 20 (x1 + x2)/42 gives the working pressure angle aw = 22.0176 degrees and centres 42 cos 20 / cos aw = 42.5719, 0.5719 further apart than unshifted; the tips are shortened by k = x1 + x2 - 0.5719/2 = 0.01404 module so each still clears the other's root by exactly 0.25 module (0.5 mm): pinion tip 14.5719, wheel tip 31.9719. Every tooth is thinned by 0.1 / (2 cos 20) = 0.05321 at its reference circle, which is 0.05 along the line of action, and involute flanks in mesh keep one gap along it at every angle, so between_bodies reads backlash / 2 = 0.050 - a wrong centre distance would move it by its error times sin aw, and a wrong tooth thickness by the error times cos 20. Closed-form volumes 3805.988 (pinion) and 22246.937 (wheel) mm3; the mesh reads 0.067 % and 0.029 % under them. The pinion's size is 2 x 14.5719 across two tips, read 2 microns short at the mesh's tip vertices. Contact ratio 1.415.
